title: 1988 AHSME Problem 11
statement: On each horizontal line in the figure below, the five large dots indicate the populations of cities \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) \(D,\) and \(E\) in the year indicated. Which city had the greatest percentage increase in population from \(1970\) to \(1980?\)

solutions.text:
The percentage increases for \(A,B,C,D,E\) are respectively \(\frac{10}{40},\frac{20}{50},\frac{30}{70},\frac{30}{100},\) and \(\frac{40}{120}.\) These are \(25\%,40\%,42\frac67\%,30\%,\) and \(33\frac13\%,\) so city \(C\) has the greatest percentage increase.

Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: Read each city’s two population values from the scale
Compare increase divided by the \(1970\) population, not just absolute increase
